title: Three failed launches, then $4 billion: the story of Webflow
disclosure: AFFILIATE LINK IN DESCRIPTION - AI VOICE

scenes.narration: 2012. A young father has a family to support. His startup has just been rejected by Y Combinator, and his savings are running out.

title: THREE FAILURES,
THEN THE 4TH TRY
scenes.subtitle: THE STORY OF WEBFLOW
scenes.narration: This is the story of Webflow, and of a founder who failed three times before it finally worked.

scenes.label: THE IDEA
scenes.narration: It starts around 2004. Vlad Magdalin has an idea: let designers build real websites visually, without writing code by hand.

scenes.label: ATTEMPTS
scenes.narration: He tries to launch it in 2005. It fails. He tries again in 2007. It fails. And again in 2008. Nothing.

scenes.label: INTUIT
scenes.narration: Meanwhile he keeps a steady job at Intuit, the finance software company. There he works with an engineer named Bryant Chou.

scenes.label: DAY JOB
scenes.narration: One day Vlad quits. He calls his brother Sergie, and with Bryant, the three of them start again.

scenes.label: TRY NUMBER 4
scenes.narration: Attempt number four. Three co-founders, no real salary, and a demo that does not really work yet.

scenes.label: Y COMBINATOR
scenes.narration: They apply to Y Combinator, the famous startup program. With a broken demo and zero traction, they are turned down.
Money runs out fast. Reports say the founders spent their savings and took on personal debt to keep going.

scenes.label: PROTOTYPE
scenes.narration: In March 2013 they post a working prototype of Webflow on Hacker News, a popular website for programmers and startup people.

scenes.label: SERVER ROOM
scenes.narration: By the next morning, about twenty thousand people have joined the waitlist. Some reports say even more.

scenes.label: Y COMBINATOR
scenes.narration: They apply to Y Combinator again. This time they get in, and join the summer 2013 batch.
Designers, freelancers and agencies start paying for it. Year after year, the team grows, floor by floor.

scenes.label: DEAL ROOM
scenes.narration: March 2022. Webflow raises one hundred twenty million dollars, at a valuation of four billion dollars.
At that time, reports say it makes about one hundred million dollars a year in recurring revenue, with over three and a half million users.

scenes.label: CEO SUITE
scenes.narration: In 2024, Vlad hands the CEO job to Linda Tong. He becomes Chief Innovation Officer and stays on as board chair.

scenes.label: TODAY
scenes.narration: Three failed launches, one rejection, and years of money trouble. Then a company valued at four billion dollars. The fourth try changed everything.

scenes.label: TRY IT
scenes.caption: FREE STARTER PLAN

scenes.label: YOUR FIRST SITE
